Stale-row cleanup (deletes numbers Meta no longer returned) only runs when the fetch was FULLY successful — skipped on any partial WABA failure, so a transient one-WABA blip never wipes that WABA's cached rows. Fire-and-forget from SecurityService.login() and WabaController.create() — never blocks, never throws.
